meta.description: One of Greece's oldest tattoo studios, est. 2001. Realistic, graphic, geometric & lettering tattoos and piercing. Glyfada & Corfu.

hero.tagline: One of Greece's oldest tattoo & piercing studios. Realism, lettering, colour and fine-line, by four artists across Glyfada and Corfu.

intro.heading: Twenty-five years of ink. No shortcuts.
intro.body: Since 2001 we've been building skin and stories. Four artists, two cities, one obsession with detail: from photoreal portraits to clean geometry and hand-built lettering.

pages.piercingSubtitle: Professional piercing in a sterile, safe environment, with high-quality jewellery.
pages.piercingIntro: From lobe and helix to septum and daith, we design the composition that suits you. We use single-use sterile equipment and implant-grade jewellery only.
pages.expectBody: Placement consultation, marking, sterilisation and the piercing itself: quick and careful. We walk you through aftercare in detail before you leave.
pages.aftercare1: Clean once or twice daily with sterile saline solution.
pages.aftercare2: Don't touch or twist the jewellery with unwashed hands.
pages.aftercare3: Avoid pools, the sea and saunas for 2–3 weeks.
pages.aftercare4: Let any crust fall off on its own. Don't pick it.
pages.aboutSubtitle: One of the oldest tattoo studios in Greece.
pages.aboutP1: Unicorn Tattoo was founded in 2001 in Glyfada. Twenty-five years on, we hold the same obsession: right design, clean execution, skin that lasts.
pages.aboutP2: Today we work across two cities, Glyfada and Corfu, with a team covering realistic, graphic, geometric and lettering, alongside professional piercing and in-house graphic art.
pages.aboutP3: Beyond the studio we design custom apparel and take part in conventions, sharing our work with the wider tattoo community.
pages.philosophyBody: Every piece starts with a conversation. We design it together, at your pace, so the result is yours, not another sheet of flash.
pages.studiosSubtitle: Glyfada and Corfu. Pick a studio to see the map and details.
pages.contactBody: Send us a message with your idea, placement and size, and we'll get back to you with availability.
